title.en: Daily Sprint, rankings, and reward store
title.zh: 每日速成、排行榜与积分兑换

purpose.en: Give subscribed learners a short, configurable five-skill learning loop and turn earned course reward points into visible progress and owned digital rewards.
purpose.zh: 为已订阅学员提供可选时长的五技能速成学习闭环，并让课程奖励积分同时体现为排行榜成绩和可拥有的数字奖励。

en: Add Daily Sprint as the first course learning choice with 5, 10, 15, or 20 minutes and a 10-minute default.
Run one mixed five-skill round per five minutes: ten vocabulary items with follow-me practice, reading, listening word order, translated writing word order, and speaking.
Add server-graded daily and weekly Sprint rankings to Play.
Add a Play reward store where signed-in learners can redeem course reward points for account-owned digital items.
zh: 把每日速成设为课程学习第一项，可选 5、10、15 或 20 分钟，默认 10 分钟。
每 5 分钟完成一轮五技能混合学习：10 个词汇与跟读、阅读、听力组句、母语提示写作组句和口语。
在边玩边学中增加由服务器评分的每日与每周速成排行榜。
在边玩边学中增加积分兑换页，登录学员可使用课程奖励积分拥有数字物品。

en: Build each Sprint from the course's reviewed vocabulary and 120-sentence bank without exposing answer keys to the client.
Persist Sprint plans and completed server-derived scores for authenticated active course members.
Create a versioned digital reward catalog, redemption ownership records, and an atomic reward-point ledger debit.
Keep anonymous Play browsing public while requiring sign-in for personal balances, ownership, Sprint entry, and redemption.
zh: 每日速成使用课程已审核词汇和 120 句题库生成，客户端不暴露答案。
仅为已登录且课程有效的学员保存速成计划和服务器计算的完成分数。
建立带版本的数字奖励目录、兑换拥有记录和原子化奖励积分扣账。
匿名用户仍可浏览边玩边学；个人余额、物品拥有、速成学习和兑换均要求登录。

en: TypeScript compilation and the production build pass.
All 324 repository tests pass, including duration, unique vocabulary, server scoring, route authorization, UI, and migration contracts.
The D1 migration applies successfully to a local Wrangler database, including the reward ledger rebuild and redemption triggers.
Shared site policy, architecture, base-feature consistency, and all 11 SmartLingo shared contracts pass.
zh: TypeScript 编译与正式构建通过。
仓库 324 项测试全部通过，包括时长、唯一词汇、服务器评分、路由授权、界面和迁移合同。
D1 迁移已在本地 Wrangler 数据库成功执行，包括奖励账本重建与兑换触发器。
共享站点政策、架构、基础功能一致性及 SmartLingo 全部 11 项共享合同通过。

en: Automated browser QA cannot supply a real human microphone sample; speech permission and non-audio fallback remain covered by contracts and production UI checks.
zh: 自动浏览器验收无法提供真人麦克风语音样本；语音权限与无音频回退仍由合同测试及正式站界面检查覆盖。

en: This is a SmartLingo learning feature. It reuses the existing course vocabulary, sentence, speech, membership, and reward boundaries without changing other sites.
zh: 这是 SmartLingo 专属学习功能，复用现有课程词汇、句子、语音、会员与奖励边界，不改变其他站点。
